besluite.fout: 'en' joins a contrast weakly, so 'net hitte beweeg' trails as an afterthought
besluite.rede: Two short sentences state the cold-does-not-enter / only-heat-moves contrast more crisply for Grade 5, with the same meaning.

besluite.fout: the clipped ellipsis 'en die draad glad nie' reads incomplete
besluite.rede: 'maar glad nie die draad nie' is the natural Afrikaans contrast with the full negative frame, and the same things are attracted and not attracted.

besluite.fout: 'Om metaal te wees beteken nie om magneties te wees nie' copies the English 'being X does not mean being Y'
besluite.rede: 'Nie alle metale is dus magneties nie' says the same thing in plain Afrikaans and follows directly from the list of unattracted metals before it.
'Verf lê bo-op' and 'daaronder' already place the scratch in the paint; the addition lengthens the sentence and repeats 'verf'.
